name: users
purpose: Minimal account identity; no inferred sensitive attributes.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active','suspended','deleting','deleted'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
notes: Normalize/verify email in the service. Delete or minimize identity fields on confirmed deletion. Authorize by immutable id, not email.

name: auth_identities
purpose: Bind a verified identity-provider subject to one member.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
notes: Identity linking requires reauthentication; provider/subject uniqueness prevents duplicate account bindings.

name: sessions
purpose: Revocable first-party sessions; raw bearer values are never stored.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
last_seen_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
notes: Use cryptographic token hashes and secure cookies. Staff role change revokes or re-evaluates privileged sessions.

name: auth_challenges
purpose: Single-use passwordless sign-in challenges.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
purpose text NOT NULL CHECK (purpose IN ('sign_in','link_identity','reauthenticate'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
notes: Consume atomically with expiry validation. Return path must be same-origin allowlisted; purge expired rows promptly.

name: roles
purpose: Fixed application capability bundles.
notes: Seed reader, editor, publisher, curator, rights_reviewer, operator and administrator. Application validates the capability vocabulary.

name: user_roles
purpose: Audited staff and reader role assignments.
columns: user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
role_code text NOT NULL REFERENCES roles(code)
assigned_by uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
assigned_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
notes: Do not allow application readers to self-assign. Administrator changes are transactional with audit.

name: user_preferences
purpose: Presentation preferences and explicit home mode.
columns: user_id uuid PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
theme text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'system' CHECK (theme IN ('light','dark','system'))
text_size text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'standard' CHECK (text_size IN ('small','standard','large'))
reduce_motion boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
home_mode text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'editorial' CHECK (home_mode IN ('editorial','following'))
updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
notes: Validate IANA timezone and language in contracts. OS reduced motion overrides decorative user motion preferences.

name: consents
purpose: Versioned consent decisions rather than one mutable checkbox.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
user_id uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
recorded_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
notes: Store minimal pseudonymous anonymous consent only where needed; deletion and expiry follow the specific purpose.

name: topics
purpose: Editorial desks and topic metadata.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active','archived'))
notes: Seed the six launch desks. Route aliases for renamed slugs are handled by the redirects table.

name: topic_follows
purpose: Only explicitly selected topic interests.
columns: user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
topic_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES topics(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
notes: This relation powers For you. No inferred political, health or religious classification is stored.

name: sources
purpose: Editorial source identity independent of individual items.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
source_type text NOT NULL CHECK (source_type IN ('publisher','channel','institution','specialist'))
status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'proposed' CHECK (status IN ('proposed','discovery_only','active','suspended','archived'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
notes: identity_key is a verified canonical domain or channel/institution identifier. Public suitability scope is not a universal truth ranking.

name: source_ownerships
purpose: Time-bounded disclosed ownership relationships.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
source_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES sources(id)
CHECK (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_from IS NULL OR valid_to >= valid_from)
notes: Ownership and independent reporting origins are distinct concepts. Unknown ownership remains unknown.

name: source_reviews
purpose: Append-only editorial source suitability decisions.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
source_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES sources(id)
reviewer_id uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
decision text NOT NULL CHECK (decision IN ('approve','restrict','reject','suspend'))
reviewed_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
notes: Detailed private review is separated from sources.public_rationale. Changing a decision means inserting another record.

name: rights_grants
purpose: Scoped, versioned permission decisions for processing and display.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
source_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES sources(id)
status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending','active','revoked','expired'))
allow_discovery boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
allow_fetch boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
allow_store boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
allow_model boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
allow_synthesis boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
allow_public_excerpt boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
allow_media boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
approved_by uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
CHECK (ends_at IS NULL OR ends_at > starts_at)
notes: Scope must include exact content, territory and approved downstream providers where relevant. Grant revision is immutable; revocation is an auditable state change. No permission defaults to true.

name: source_endpoints
purpose: Provider-specific discovery and fetch configuration.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
source_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES sources(id)
adapter text NOT NULL CHECK (adapter IN ('rss','atom','licensed_api','approved_web','publisher_upload','youtube_display'))
status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'paused' CHECK (status IN ('active','paused','failed'))
poll_interval_seconds integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 900 CHECK (poll_interval_seconds >= 60)
notes: Store references to credentials only. JSON contains non-secret validated adapter settings, limits, quota buckets and cursor.

name: source_items
purpose: Stable identity of an original article, document or video.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
source_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES sources(id)
kind text NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('article','video','document','transcript','audio'))
first_seen_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
notes: Different URLs can refer to one item; conservative canonicalization must preserve semantic parameters. URL may be a publisher transcript URL with separately associated video.

name: source_item_versions
purpose: Immutable retrieved/extracted item revision and permission lineage.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
fetched_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
eligibility text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'needs_review' CHECK (eligibility IN ('metadata_only','needs_review','eligible','denied','withdrawn'))
FOREIGN KEY (item_id, source_id) REFERENCES source_items(id, source_id)
FOREIGN KEY (rights_grant_id, source_id) REFERENCES rights_grants(id, source_id)
notes: A changed body creates another version. Restricted API metadata, independently licensed transcripts and raw bodies need distinct retention rules, including any public attribution metadata subject to refresh.

name: source_observations
purpose: Each retrieval/availability check, including repeated unchanged content.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
item_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES source_items(id)
observed_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
availability text NOT NULL CHECK (availability IN ('available','unchanged','unavailable','denied'))
FOREIGN KEY (source_version_id, item_id) REFERENCES source_item_versions(id, item_id)
notes: Unchanged fetches point to the existing checksum version. An A-B-A content sequence is preserved by observations without duplicating source content. Apply provider metadata retention to these records too.

name: media_assets
purpose: Owned or licensed illustrative/document assets.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
is_owned boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
CHECK (is_owned OR rights_grant_id IS NOT NULL)
notes: YouTube audiovisual files are not downloaded into this table. Only separately permitted assets or owned product visuals belong here.

name: reporting_origins
purpose: Independently established underlying reporting/primary origin.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
origin_type text NOT NULL CHECK (origin_type IN ('original_reporting','primary_document','wire_report','unknown'))
verified_by uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
notes: A wire story reproduced by many publishers remains one origin. Unknown origins do not satisfy independence gates.

name: item_origins
purpose: Many-to-many provenance of an item revision.
columns: source_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES source_item_versions(id)
origin_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES reporting_origins(id)
relationship text NOT NULL CHECK (relationship IN ('original','reprint','derived','cites'))
counts_for_independence boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
notes: Independence eligibility is a reviewed judgment. New source revisions can alter attribution and invalidate article approval.

name: story_clusters
purpose: Bounded event/question grouping with revision.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'candidate' CHECK (status IN ('candidate','ready','merged','archived'))
revision integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (revision > 0)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
CHECK (event_end_at IS NULL OR event_start_at IS NULL OR event_end_at >= event_start_at)
CHECK (merged_into_id IS NULL OR merged_into_id <> id)
notes: Merge/split logic also prevents cycles and invalidates evidence packs transactionally. Similarity does not override event/date distinctions.

name: cluster_items
purpose: Membership of exact item versions in event clusters.
columns: cluster_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES story_clusters(id)
source_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES source_item_versions(id)
reviewed_by uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
added_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
notes: An item may discuss multiple events; many-to-many membership is intentional.

name: evidence_spans
purpose: Checksum-bound text/page/time locator.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
source_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES source_item_versions(id)
quality text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'needs_review' CHECK (quality IN ('needs_review','verified','rejected'))
CHECK ((start_char IS NULL AND end_char IS NULL) OR (start_char IS NOT NULL AND end_char IS NOT NULL AND end_char > start_char))
CHECK ((start_ms IS NULL AND end_ms IS NULL) OR (start_ms IS NOT NULL AND end_ms IS NOT NULL AND end_ms > start_ms))
notes: Validate char offsets against exact normalized content and times against duration. Public excerpt permission is checked separately from private retention.

name: claims
purpose: Atomic checkable propositions tied to an event cluster.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
cluster_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES story_clusters(id)
status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unresolved' CHECK (status IN ('corroborated','attributed','disputed','unresolved','rejected'))
risk text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'normal' CHECK (risk IN ('normal','high'))
notes: A semantic change creates a new claim ID or revision in application logic; existing reviewed article mappings must not silently inherit edits.

name: claim_evidence
purpose: Support, contradiction or context edge to exact evidence.
columns: claim_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES claims(id)
relation text NOT NULL CHECK (relation IN ('supports','contradicts','context'))
verified_by uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
FOREIGN KEY (evidence_span_id, source_version_id) REFERENCES evidence_spans(id, source_version_id)
notes: The span must belong to the asserted source version. Text matching alone cannot set verified_by.

name: articles
purpose: Stable public article identity and current safe version pointer.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
cluster_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES story_clusters(id)
status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft','published','withdrawn','archived'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
notes: The current-version composite foreign key is added after article_versions exists. Public visibility is checked at serving time.

name: article_versions
purpose: One content-and-evidence approval unit.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
state text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (state IN ('queued','generating','draft','in_review','approved','published','rejected','withdrawn','redacted'))
risk text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'normal' CHECK (risk IN ('normal','high'))
created_by uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
FOREIGN KEY (article_id, cluster_id) REFERENCES articles(id, cluster_id)
notes: Hashes cover every factual surface, variant, claim, citation, origin and grant revision. Publication append-only history determines whether content is immutable.

name: article_variants
purpose: Pre-reviewed reading length/language within a version.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES article_versions(id)
variant text NOT NULL CHECK (variant IN ('standard','brief'))
notes: Translations are V1 and require separately recorded validation/approval coverage. Search text contains only the product narrative, not source bodies.

name: article_blocks
purpose: Ordered structured article content including factual headlines/decks.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
block_type text NOT NULL CHECK (block_type IN ('headline','deck','heading','paragraph','key_point','quote','uncertainty','disclosure'))
is_factual boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true
FOREIGN KEY (variant_id, version_id) REFERENCES article_variants(id, version_id)
notes: Renderer accepts a constrained structure, not arbitrary model HTML. Header fields must agree with headline/deck blocks under canonical hashing.

name: article_claims
purpose: Claims selected into one article version.
columns: material boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true
FOREIGN KEY (version_id, cluster_id) REFERENCES article_versions(id, cluster_id)
FOREIGN KEY (claim_id, cluster_id) REFERENCES claims(id, cluster_id)
notes: Composite keys prevent attaching a claim from a different event cluster without an explicit remapping.

name: block_claims
purpose: Every factual displayed block links to its reviewed claims.
columns: FOREIGN KEY (block_id, version_id) REFERENCES article_blocks(id, version_id)
FOREIGN KEY (version_id, claim_id) REFERENCES article_claims(version_id, claim_id)
notes: The publish service requires mappings for every material factual block across both variants, including key points and headings when factual.

name: article_sources
purpose: Stable numbered bibliography for an article version.
columns: version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES article_versions(id)
source_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES source_item_versions(id)
usage text NOT NULL CHECK (usage IN ('evidence','context','related'))
notes: Store source identity, not model-generated URLs. Numbering is stable for the entire version; related items never count toward evidence requirements.

name: claim_citations
purpose: Public claim reference to an included source and verified span.
columns: FOREIGN KEY (version_id, claim_id) REFERENCES article_claims(version_id, claim_id)
FOREIGN KEY (version_id, source_version_id) REFERENCES article_sources(version_id, source_version_id)
FOREIGN KEY (claim_id, evidence_span_id, source_version_id) REFERENCES claim_evidence(claim_id, evidence_span_id, source_version_id)
notes: These foreign keys prevent a valid-looking citation to a source/span outside the selected version and claim.

name: article_topics
purpose: Multiple desks with at most one primary designation.
columns: article_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES articles(id)
topic_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES topics(id)
is_primary boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
notes: A partial unique index enforces at most one primary topic; publish service requires exactly one.

name: article_relations
purpose: Context links and ongoing-story relationships.
columns: article_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES articles(id)
related_article_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES articles(id)
relation text NOT NULL CHECK (relation IN ('background','follow_up','related'))
notes: Public projection checks visibility of both ends and caps reader recommendations to three.

name: bookmarks
purpose: Private saved article identity and first-viewed version.
columns: user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
article_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES articles(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
FOREIGN KEY (saved_version_id, article_id) REFERENCES article_versions(id, article_id)
notes: Current safe content opens by default. Saved historical references never authorize access to withdrawn text.

name: generation_runs
purpose: Reproducible generation attempts and measured usage.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
cluster_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES story_clusters(id)
FOREIGN KEY (version_id, cluster_id) REFERENCES article_versions(id, cluster_id)
status text NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('queued','running','succeeded','failed','canceled'))
notes: input_manifest contains IDs/hashes rather than an unrestricted full prompt. Full prompt storage needs the same source permissions and retention.

name: validation_results
purpose: Digest-bound individual validation outcomes.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES article_versions(id)
result text NOT NULL CHECK (result IN ('pass','warn','fail'))
severity text NOT NULL CHECK (severity IN ('info','major','critical'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
notes: Publish selects results for the exact current digest and required check versions; old passing checks are not reusable after edits.

name: review_assignments
purpose: Work ownership without conferring approval.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES article_versions(id)
reviewer_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id)
assigned_by uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open' CHECK (status IN ('open','completed','canceled'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
notes: Assignments may be reassigned with audit. High-risk approval distinctness is by actual reviewer identity, not assignment row count.

name: editorial_reviews
purpose: Human decisions bound to immutable approval digest.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES article_versions(id)
reviewer_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id)
decision text NOT NULL CHECK (decision IN ('approve','changes_requested','reject','revoke'))
reviewed_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
notes: Application selects the exact digest and correct reviewer capabilities. Reviews are append-only; new decisions on changed drafts carry new digests.

name: publication_events
purpose: Durable append-only publication, correction and withdrawal history.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
article_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES articles(id)
actor_id uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
event_type text NOT NULL CHECK (event_type IN ('publish','update','correct','withdraw','restore','redact'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
FOREIGN KEY (version_id, article_id) REFERENCES article_versions(id, article_id)
notes: Inserted in the same transaction as the public pointer change and outbox. Public reason is scrubbed of private report details.

name: reader_reports
purpose: Version-specific factual/attribution/rights reports.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
article_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES articles(id)
reporter_user_id uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
severity text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'normal' CHECK (severity IN ('normal','urgent'))
status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'received' CHECK (status IN ('received','triaged','investigating','action_required','no_change','resolved','duplicate'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
FOREIGN KEY (version_id, article_id) REFERENCES article_versions(id, article_id)
FOREIGN KEY (version_id, claim_id) REFERENCES article_claims(version_id, claim_id)
notes: Optional email is private PII, encrypted under deployment policy and excluded from logs/public corrections. Rate-limit before creating rows.

name: corrections
purpose: Public change notice connected to private investigation.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
article_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES articles(id)
FOREIGN KEY (report_id, article_id) REFERENCES reader_reports(id, article_id)
severity text NOT NULL CHECK (severity IN ('minor','material','critical'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
FOREIGN KEY (from_version_id, article_id) REFERENCES article_versions(id, article_id)
FOREIGN KEY (to_version_id, article_id) REFERENCES article_versions(id, article_id)
notes: The two versions must belong to the same article. A withdrawal may have no replacement version.

name: takedowns
purpose: Source- or article-scoped suppression and remediation.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open' CHECK (status IN ('open','suppressed','remediating','completed'))
requested_by uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
notes: Impact traversal finds all variants, blocks, prompts, excerpts, assets, search/cache entries and future messages. More than one target is permitted when explicit.

name: ingestion_runs
purpose: Scheduled endpoint poll/fetch attempts and counters.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
endpoint_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES source_endpoints(id)
status text NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('queued','running','succeeded','partial','failed'))
item_count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (item_count >= 0)
correlation_id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
notes: Source text is not stored in error messages. Provider-specific quota consumption is validated metadata.

name: processing_jobs
purpose: Authoritative job state, attempts and lease.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued' CHECK (status IN ('queued','running','succeeded','failed','quarantined','canceled'))
attempts integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (attempts >= 0)
max_attempts integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 5 CHECK (max_attempts > 0)
next_attempt_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
correlation_id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
notes: Payload is schema-validated identifiers, not credentials or raw content. PostgreSQL uniqueness survives Redis loss.

name: outbox_events
purpose: Transactional events for cache, search, jobs and retention effects.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
attempts integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (attempts >= 0)
notes: Consumers are idempotent. dispatched_at indicates dispatch, not proof that every downstream side effect succeeded.

name: audit_events
purpose: Append-only minimal action record.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
notes: actor_token is a pseudonymous staff/service reference, not an email. Map to identity separately under retention policy. No source bodies, passwords or secrets.

name: privacy_requests
purpose: User export/deletion workflow with secure expiry.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
user_id uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
request_type text NOT NULL CHECK (request_type IN ('export','delete'))
status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'requested' CHECK (status IN ('requested','confirmed','queued','processing','completed','failed','canceled'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
notes: Keep the minimum deletion-ledger evidence after account identity is removed. A status token is not sufficient authorization for export.

name: retention_tasks
purpose: Auditable source and personal-data purge work.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
action text NOT NULL CHECK (action IN ('delete','refresh','redact','invalidate'))
status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued' CHECK (status IN ('queued','processing','completed','failed'))
notes: Use one task per derived target with durable outcome. Refresh obligations and deletion deadlines are distinct from job retry deadlines.

name: analytics_events
purpose: Minimal first-party events for defined product metrics.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
CHECK (version_id IS NULL OR article_id IS NOT NULL)
FOREIGN KEY (version_id, article_id) REFERENCES article_versions(id, article_id)
occurred_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
notes: Allowlist event properties; no raw query, full URL containing secrets, email or source body. Consent and bot/staff exclusion are service policies.

name: feature_flags
purpose: Audited rollout, budget and kill-switch configuration.
columns: revision integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (revision > 0)
updated_by uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
notes: Separate intake, generation, publication, video display and emergency suppression flags. Configuration schemas are versioned.

name: redirects
purpose: Stable internal route aliases for renamed article/topic slugs.
columns: status_code integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 301 CHECK (status_code IN (301,308))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
notes: Service restricts both paths to same-origin routes and prevents redirect cycles; preserve safe version/claim parameters.

name: notification_preferences
purpose: Explicit communication opt-in; not enabled at launch.
columns: user_id uuid PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
cadence text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'weekly' CHECK (cadence IN ('daily','weekly'))
updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
notes: V1 migration only. Consent and timezone validation are required; later story-specific subscriptions need an extension relation.

name: notification_deliveries
purpose: Idempotent future digest/alert deliveries.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
channel text NOT NULL CHECK (channel IN ('email'))
status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued' CHECK (status IN ('queued','sending','sent','suppressed','failed','ambiguous'))
notes: Provider idempotency/reconciliation is necessary after ambiguous timeout. JSON version IDs require service validation and pre-send publication checks.

name: source_suggestions
purpose: Quarantined reader suggestions, never direct fetch commands.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'quarantined' CHECK (status IN ('quarantined','reviewing','accepted','rejected','duplicate'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
notes: V1 moderation is required before any network fetch. Unknown URL data is escaped in staff tools.
